response: Saved Views is available today and included in all paid plans. If you've ever rebuilt the same filtered board, sorted backlog, or grouped-by-assignee list more than once, this feature removes that repetition for good. With Saved Views, you can capture any combination of filters, sorting, grouping, and column settings, then return to that exact configuration with a single click, whenever you need it. Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to organize by project, sprint, client, or personal workflow, without cluttering your workspace or losing track of older setups. Views aren't limited to your own screen, either: any saved view can be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same layout instead of recreating it individually, which keeps reporting consistent and onboarding faster for new teammates joining ongoing projects. Saved Views is rolling out now across web and desktop apps, with no separate purchase or add-on required to unlock it. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
